title: The Missing Ring, Part 3
description: The Missing Ring, Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chairman Manchair

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go anywhere within Upper MutantMania and rough up the locals until they give up the stolen fight ring ropes. Bring the recovered ropes to Chairman Manchair in the All-Amateur Assault off MutantMania's Level 3.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Chairman Manchair

Repeatable: No

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go anywhere within Upper MutantMania and rough up the locals until they give up the stolen fight ring ropes. Bring the recovered ropes to Chairman Manchair in the All-Amateur Assault off MutantMania's Level 3.

Offer:

Nelly Virago, here. Ace reporter for MutantMania Monthly Magazine. My readers are impressed that you were able to recover the missing All-Amateur Assault Polyhedral Circle Pan-Community Project Committee fight ring posts. But now they demand to know: Can you do the same with the missing AAAPCPCPC fight ring ropes?

You might think you can, but don't commit yourself too soon, champ. You had to retrieve *eight* posts, but there are *thirty-two* ropes still missing. If you can collect all the missing ropes and bring them to Chairman Manchair in the All-Amateur Assault off MutantMania's Level 3, now that would be worth a paragraph or two in my next article!

Turn-in:

Crikey! Ye found the missing ropes! Ye be doin' a fine thing for the All-Amateur Assault. We'll attach these ropes to the posts ye recovered straight away. The only thing still missing are our stools and buckets for the competitors. Would ye ask ace reporter Nelly Virago if she knows where we they are?

Objectives:

  • Fight Ring Posts ×32

Level range: 81–100
